description: This file defines functions to create and organize editor menu groups based on note types, installed components, and native features within a web application.

methods.name: getNoteTypeForFeatureDescription
methods.description: Determines the NoteType based on feature description's note_type or file_type.

methods.name: insertNonInstalledNativeComponentsInMap
methods.description: Adds native components that are not installed and are showable to the map based on feature description.

methods.name: insertInstalledComponentsInMap
methods.description: Adds installed components to the map with their entitlement status.

methods.name: createGroupsFromMap
methods.description: Creates organized editor menu groups from the map of note types.

methods.name: createBaselineMap
methods.description: Initializes the map with default note types and their corresponding menu items.

methods.name: createEditorMenuGroups
methods.description: Main exported function that creates editor menu groups based on application state and components.
